# Town of Sunderland municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 23; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Sunderland, Official Return of Votes, Australian ballot election of March 3, 2026 (certified; town website): the moderator election was write-in only -- incumbent Alyson Grzyb received 20 of 164 votes cast (135 blank) and the return declares no winner; no post-election roster names a moderator, so no membership is created (a write-in plurality alone does not seat)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Sunderland, FY25 Annual Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town website): Caroline Hartshorn, Town Clerk, three-year term to 2028
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Caroline Hartshorn as Sunderland's Town Clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names her in the fuller form 'Caroline Morse Hartshorn'; the town's own documents use Caroline Hartshorn, which governs
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Sunderland, FY25 Annual Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town website): Caroline Hartshorn, Town Treasurer, three-year term to 2028
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Caroline Hartshorn as Sunderland's Town Treasurer

Town of Sunderland, FY25 Annual Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town website): names Todd Lawrence (Chair), Martin Nadler, Richard Timmerman, Anthony Thompson, and Bruce Mattison, whose three-year term expired in 2026

Town of Sunderland, Official Return of Votes, Australian ballot election of March 3, 2026 (certified; town website): Richard Timmerman re-won a one-year seat with 118 votes and Anthony Thompson with 117; the ballot for Mattison's expiring seat drew only scattered write-ins (top count 13) and declared no winner
Town of Sunderland, selectboard minutes of April 13, 2026: the board seats four members only
Town of Sunderland, selectboard minutes of October 12, 2026: the board still seats four members; the fifth seat stands vacant
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms
Town of Sunderland, FY25 Annual Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town website): Peter Van Vleck Jr. (term to 2027) and Neil Humphrey (to 2028); Robert Goodfellow's seat expired in 2026

Town of Sunderland, Official Return of Votes, Australian ballot election of March 3, 2026 (certified; town website): the 2026 ballot for the expiring lister seat was write-in only and tied at one vote each, so no winner is recorded

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Sunderland, FY25 Annual Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town website): one auditor seat stood vacant and Theodore Rappahahn served as an appointed auditor to 2026

Town of Sunderland, Official Return of Votes, Australian ballot election of March 3, 2026 (certified; town website): all three auditor seats were write-in only in 2026 (counts of one to six) with no declared winners, so no memberships are created
Town of Sunderland, FY25 Annual Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town website): Avis Hayden (term to 2027) and Neil Humphrey (to 2028); Kathleen Johnston's seat expired in 2026

Town of Sunderland, Official Return of Votes, Australian ballot election of March 3, 2026 (certified; town website): the 2026 ballot for the expiring cemetery seat drew inconclusive write-ins, so no third membership is created

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes

Town of Sunderland, Official Return of Votes, Australian ballot election of March 3, 2026 (certified; town website): Allison Murphy was elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes with 140 votes on the printed ballot
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect constables

Town of Sunderland, Official Return of Votes, Australian ballot election of March 3, 2026 (certified; town website): Kevin Hewes was elected First Constable with 126 votes on the printed ballot (he moved up from Second Constable)
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect constables); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Sunderland, Official Return of Votes, Australian ballot election of March 3, 2026 (certified; town website): the 2026 second constable ballot was write-in only and tied at one vote each, so no membership is created
